description: issue #775 (review gate, QA finding B5): `wait :t` where `:t` is a TURTLE -- the seventh and last arm of `params.actual` for the shared whole-number check, pinned alongside the other four non-number/word arms. `spec/error-model.md` requires an `ol-type` to name the learner concept, and `turtle` is a first-class value (`spec/turtles-and-sprites.md`), so a turtle count must be reported as a turtle -- not silently relabelled. Mislabelling ONLY this arm passed a fully green run until this fixture existed (found by mutation), because the other arms are each pinned by their own fixture and nothing reached this one. A turtle's `params.value` is pinned as `{ "id": 1 }` -- the exact shape `sprites/turtle-type-diagnostic` already binds -- alongside the `list`, `boolean`, `dict`, and `record` arms, which their own fixtures pin (the harness unwraps an `OLDict`/`OLRecord` into a plain key->value object before deep-comparing, so those compare contents too). Needs the Sprites profile only to CONSTRUCT the turtle (`new_turtle`); the check under test is the Interaction one. The `spawn-turtle` event from the assignment precedes the `wait` instruction; the `primitive` event is NOT emitted (the pause never runs) and the span covers just the argument. Its `every` twin is `every/every-turtle-type-error`.
